净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Drawdown depth normalized by recent volatility (ATR/close) isolates the magnitude of price decline relative to typical daily movement, improving cross-sectional comparability without artificial ranking. The 60-day window captures intermediate-term stress, while 20-day ATR provides a responsive volatility scaling. No cross-sectional transform is needed as the ratio naturally scales across stocks.

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(divide(subtract(ts_max(AdjClose, 60), AdjClose), ts_max(AdjClose, 60)), divide(ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 20), AdjClose))
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(ts_max(AdjClose, 60), AdjClose), ts_max(AdjClose, 60))
  3. 3. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(ts_max(AdjClose, 60), AdjClose)
  4. 4. ts_max —— 过去 N 天滚动最大值
    ts_max(AdjClose, 60)
  5. 5. ts_max —— 过去 N 天滚动最大值
    ts_max(AdjClose, 60)
  6. 6. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 20), AdjClose)
  7. 7. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 20)

列含义说明

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
true_range真实波幅 TR = max(H-L, |H-C|, |L-C|)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 roll_max：close.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=60).max()
  2. 计算 drawdown：(roll_max - close) / roll_max
  3. 计算 atr：pd.Series(talib.ATR(high.astype(np.float64).values, low.astype(np.float64).values, close.astype(np.float64).values, timeperiod=20), index=df_copy.index)
  4. 计算 atr_ratio：atr / close
  5. 计算 factor：drawdown / atr_ratio
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_stress_atr(df): df_copy = df.copy() roll_max = df_copy["close"].rolling(60, min_periods=60).max() drawdown = (roll_max - df_copy["close"]) / roll_max.replace(0.0, np.nan) atr = pd.Series(talib.ATR(df_copy["high"].astype(np.float64).values, df_copy["low"].astype(np.float64).values, df_copy["close"].astype(np.float64).values, timeperiod=20), index=df_copy.index) atr_ratio = atr / df_copy["close"].replace(0.0, np.nan) factor = drawdown / atr_ratio.replace(0.0, np.nan) factor.name = "factor_drawdown_stress_atr" "kw">class="kw">return factor
